items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: One time there, Steve Lloyd Kean, a good promoter. He got the best job in town... So I got the job from Steve, see.

ctx.x: The Buckhorn? The Buckhorn. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. The chief was a long chief of police and Captain Harry Drexel. I played in there. I took Van Gaiman's place. The only two drummers played in there was Van Gaiman and me. I took Van's place. As a matter of fact, how they came about. I said, I want to get to you straight. You can't do somebody else. It's difficult, but I'm telling you it's the real truth. Van was a fine drummer. I used to go play for Van Gaiman. One time there, Steve Lloyd Kean, a good…
I knew Buck is the one.
